what: The plan updates plan-review.md but the external plan-review prompts are generated by render-plan-review-prompt.sh, so the proposed style token/directive will not reach the actual Cursor/Codex reviewer prompts.
scenario_or_breakage: Plan-review findings and OOS descriptions remain unstyled even though they are user-facing design output; the proposed lint can pass by checking the reference file while the runtime prompt stays unchanged.
suggested_fix: Add the readability preamble injection to render-plan-review-prompt.sh itself and pin it in test-plan-review-prompt.sh; include this renderer in the lint manifest or otherwise check the rendered prompt surface.

what: The plan calls this a pre-commit lint but only proposes Makefile wiring, while this repo treats .pre-commit-config.yaml as the linter source of truth for git hooks, CI lint-only, and relevant-checks.
scenario_or_breakage: pre-commit run --files and the installed git hook will not execute lint-readability-preamble.sh, so a prompt site can drift unless a developer happens to run the broader Makefile target.
suggested_fix: Add a local pre-commit hook for scripts/lint-readability-preamble.sh, likely pass_filenames false and always_run true; keep the Makefile target as a convenience wrapper if desired.
